based_in.value: Founded in Germany, now headquartered in New York

growth_signal.value: Serves over 800 customers including Zalando, Taco Bell and The Telegraph, and became Germany's second unicorn of 2026.

raised.note: confirmed by two sources in the run; the URLs were not saved
raised.value: $110M Series B at a $1B valuation, after a $35M Series A and a $9.5M seed

entry.idea: Dash0 helps engineering teams monitor their software and find the cause of problems quickly, using an open standard for collecting system data.
entry.lesson: Build on an open industry standard so customers trust you will not lock them in, then add AI on top to stand out.
entry.name: Dash0

growth.reason: It jumped from a $9.5M seed to a $1 billion valuation with over 800 paying customers in about two years.

market.reason: Every company running software online needs monitoring tools, a large but specialised engineering market.

tech.reason: Building on the open OpenTelemetry standard makes adoption easier, but rivals can build on the same open standard too.

entry.twist: It adds an AI agent, Agent0, that acts like a copilot, helping engineers find the root cause of an issue instead of just showing raw data.
entry.who_pays: Engineering and DevOps teams at companies pay to monitor and troubleshoot their software through the platform.
entry.why_now: Software systems are getting more complex and change faster, so engineering teams need AI help to catch and fix problems before customers notice.
